column2: Course Description: The objective of this course is to develop design skills and tools used in Biomedical Engineering. Integration of the engineering and life sciences will be illustrated by presenting design principles for medical devices and systems. Emphasis will be placed on engineering design for the cardiovascular and musculoskeletal systems.Antirequisite(s): MME 4470A/B.Extra Information: 3 lecture hours, 2 tutorial hours.Restricted to students registered in a Biomedical Engineering degree program.
